periods.time: five years after the Arcadia Empire coup
periods.summary: Volume 1 follows Lux Arcadia, the pardoned former prince of the fallen Arcadia Empire, as an accident brings him into the Atismata New Kingdom's girls' Royal Officer Academy. There he meets Princess Lisha, reunites with Philuffy and Airi, becomes entangled with the Knight Squadron, and finally reveals Bahamut to save Lisha and Crossfield from Belbet's old empire remnant attack.
periods.core_conflict: Lux wants to protect people while hiding his role as the Black Hero and pursuing Fugil, while the New Kingdom faces Abyss threats, old empire remnants, and unresolved political secrets around Lisha's legitimacy.
periods.atmosphere: A mix of light academy comedy and high-stakes Drag-Ride battles, overlaid with trauma from revolution, concealed identities, and the burden of royal symbolism.

timeline.summary: The old empire falls in fire; Lisha escapes with a Sword Device and the Black Hero legend begins.
Lux falls into the academy bath while recovering a stolen handbag.
Relie and Lisha turn Lux's accident into a trial by duel.
Lisha duels Lux, then cooperates with him against a Gargoyle Abyss.
Lux reunites with childhood friend Philuffy in class.
Lisha tries to add Lux to the Knight Squadron but he refuses to attack.
A huge slime Abyss approaches Crossfield from the southwest ruins.
Belbet reveals himself as an imperial remnant and weaponizes Abyss through the flute.
Lux reveals Bahamut and defeats Belbet's remnant force.
Lux is formally accepted as the academy's first male student and chore prince.

rules: Armored Drag-Rides are ancient mechanical dragon weapons summoned and controlled through Sword Devices.
General-purpose Drag-Rides include Wyvern, Wyrm, and Drake types; Divine Drag-Rides are unique, stronger, and far more burdensome.
Abyss emerge from ruins and normally attack living beings indiscriminately, but volume 1 reveals flute-based control can weaponize them.
Ruins contain Drag-Rides, relics, and ancient documents, making investigation rights a matter of international military politics.
Lux and Airi survive under a New Kingdom pardon contract marked by black collars, debt, chores, and hostage liability.
The Royal Officer Academy trains mostly female Drag-Knights because the New Kingdom rejects old empire gender restrictions and needs new military talent.

history_eras.summary: A vast patriarchal empire monopolizes Drag-Rides, oppresses citizens, and conducts abuses that drive Lux and Atismata opposition.
Earl Atismata's revolt, Lux's Black Hero actions, and Fugil's betrayal destroy the old empire.
Queen Raffi rules the liberated state while old empire remnants, Abyss, and ruin politics remain unresolved threats.
